'''Muhammad Lutfar Rahman''' (born 2 May 1942) is a Bangladeshi professor, [[chemist]] and researcher. He was sixth [[Vice-chancellor|vice chancellor]] (from 20 October 2000 to 3 November 2001) of [[Islamic University, Bangladesh]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Engineer |first=Nazmus Shahadat, Senior Software |title=Islamic University |url=https://iu.ac.bd/ |access-date=2020-11-08 |website=iu.ac.bd}}</ref> He was professor of [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]] at [[Chemistry|Chemistry department]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Mohammad Lutfor Rahman |url=https://www.scholarena.com/eb/1179/Mohammad-Lutfor-Rahman-Journal-of-Waste-Management-and-Disposal/ |access-date=2020-11-08 |website=www.scholarena.com}}</ref> He is now contract professor of Independent University, Bangladesh in Environmental Science and Management department.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=Rahman |first=Lutfor |title=Resume of Prof. M Lutfor Rahman with pic.pdf |url=https://www.academia.edu/30151230 |website=academia.edu |language=en |archive-date=2021-12-22 |access-date=2020-11-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211222041907/https://www.academia.edu/30151230 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":0" />

== Early life ==
Rahman was born on 2 May 1942 to Abul Hossain and Sikarunnesa.<ref name=":1" />

== Education ==

* '''Matriculation:''' (now [[Secondary School Certificate|SSC]]), [[Khoksa Janipur Government Pilot Secondary School]], District First (1958 Batch)<ref name=":1" />
* '''Intermediate:''' (now [[Higher Secondary School Certificate|HSC]]), [[Govt. Edward College, Pabna|Pabna Edward College]], 6th place in Rajshahi Division (1960 Batch)
* '''BSc''' (Hons) in Chemistry, [[Rajshahi College]], Year of Graduation: 1963
* '''M.Sc''' in Chemistry (Physical Chemistry), [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]]. Year of Graduation: 1964.
* '''Ph.D''' in Physical Chemistry, [[University of Cambridge]]. Year of Graduation: 1969<ref name=":1" />

== Career ==

* 1965 – 1973: Assistant Professor, Department of Chemistry, [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]].<ref name=":1" />
* 1973 – 1980: Associate Professor, Department of Chemistry, [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]]
* 1980 – 1985: Faculty of Science (on lien) [[University of Benghazi|University of Garyunis]], Libya
* 1980 – 2006: Professor, Department of Chemistry, [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]].
* 1986 – 1989: Chairman, Department of Chemistry, Rajshahi University<ref name=":1" />
* 1993 – 1995: Dean, Faculty of Science, Rajshahi University
* 1998 – 2000: [[Pro-vice-chancellor|Pro Vice Chancellor]], National University, Gazipur
* 2000 –  2001: Vice Chancellor, Islamic University, Bangladesh.
* 2006 – Now: Professor (on contract), Department of Environmental Science and Management (SESM) Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB)<ref name=":1" />
